entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Mad Felonarch of Inys Nohr and descendant of Nohr, redeemed after Aylith healed him.

entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: Land of the Far Clans, home of the Keeper, that Nazir assaulted.

entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: Ancestor of Nazir whose curse afflicts his bloodline.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: Provided Nazir a foul liquid remedy to maintain his sanity.

entities.name: Crephas
entities.description: Nazir's insane father; killed and was killed by Nazir's grandfather.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Keeper Logan's daughter, captured by Nazir, who carried the Memories of the Clan Tree and later healed him.

entities.name: Logan
entities.description: Keeper of Inys Haen and Aylith's father, whom Nazir's soldiers failed to bring back alive.

entities.name: Jedhian
entities.description: Aylith's cousin whom Nazir threatened to execute.

entities.name: Feryar
entities.description: Elf who carried Aylith's comatose body away.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: Weapon Nazir used to strike down Aylith.

entities.name: Loch Prith
entities.description: Hidden elven sanctuary where Aylith was spiritually healed.

entities.name: Clan Tree
entities.description: Tree whose Awakening Ritual and Mending restored balance to the plane.

entities.name: Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: Ritual performed by Aylith and Nazir that returned the sun and a sapling Clan Tree.

entities.name: Mirkalbion
entities.description: Oppressed slaves who revolted against Nazir.

events.summary: Nazir inherits the throne at twenty after his father and grandfather kill each other.
events.quote: leaving Nazir to inherit the throne of Inys Nohr at twenty years of age

events.summary: Nazir tries to reach Inys Haen but his birthmark burns so badly he must turn back.
events.quote: his birthmark burned so badly that he had to turn back

events.summary: Nazir's soldiers raid Inys Haen and return with Aylith but not the Keeper alive.
events.quote: they failed to bring back the Keeper alive but returned with his young daughter, Aylith

events.summary: Nazir interrogates and enchants Aylith to extract the Memories of the Clan Tree.
events.quote: He enchanted her to extract this knowledge

events.summary: Facing rebellion, Nazir strikes Aylith down with Soulslayer; Feryar carries her away.
events.quote: Nazir struck her down with Soulslayer

events.summary: Nazir abandons his fortress and assaults Inys Haen; Aylith pursues him.
events.quote: Nazir abandoned his fortress and led his best warriors in an assault on Inys Haen

events.summary: Nazir is captured; Aylith chooses to heal him of his madness and addiction.
events.quote: instead chose to heal him of his madness and addiction

events.summary: Nazir assists the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending his reign.
events.quote: Nazir assisted in performing the Awakening Ritual alongside Aylith, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree

relations.quote: Nazir was the Felonarch of Inys Nohr
He drank a foul-smelling liquid given to him by Malvos to maintain his sanity

relations.note: captured and struck her down before she healed him
relations.quote: Nazir struck her down with Soulslayer

relations.note: healed him and performed the ritual together
relations.quote: Nazir assisted in performing the Awakening Ritual alongside Aylith
